description: Complete rewrite of the voice assistant with simple Gemini-first architecture. No state machine, no local parsing. Frontend sends text to Gemini and executes the JSON response.
steps: 1. In src/renderer/renderer.js, replace the entire voice assistant section (from the comment block at ~line 3414 '/* ASISTENTE DE VOZ...' through the end of initAsistente() at ~line 4175 including 'initAsistente();' call) with the new implementation.
2. The new 'asistente' object must include a 'flujo' property: { paso: null, datos: { responsable: '', frente: '', nota: '', items: [] } }
3. Change recognition.continuous from false to true. Set recognition.interimResults = true.
4. Rewrite reactivarMicrofono() to use a maximum delay of 100ms (not 800ms).

5. Rewrite hablarAgente(texto) to PAUSE recognition before speaking (recognition.stop()) and RESUME it immediately after speech ends (restart recognition). This prevents the mic from picking up TTS output.

6. Rewrite recognition.onresult to accumulate final transcript text and process it. When final text arrives: (a) check stop words, (b) check if flujo.paso is active and route to procesarEnFlujo(texto), (c) otherwise try detectarIntencionLocal(texto), (d) fallback to enviarTextoAlAgente(texto).
7. Rewrite recognition.onend and recognition.onerror to reactivate immediately (100ms max) on unexpected stops like 'no-speech' or 'end' events, as long as asistente.escuchando is true.

8. Implement new function procesarEnFlujo(texto) that handles the conversational state machine: (a) paso='responsable': set datos.responsable from texto, fill the responsable field in the modal, advance to paso='frente', speak confirmation and ask for frente. (b) paso='frente': parse frente from texto, fill #o-frente select, advance to paso='materiales', speak confirmation and ask for materials. (c) paso='materiales': if user says 'listo'/'terminé'/'eso es todo', advance to paso='confirmar' and ask for confirmation with item count. Otherwise call parsearMaterialLocal(texto) to extract material, add to datos.items, add row in modal DOM, speak 'Agregado. Que mas?'. (d) paso='confirmar': if user says 'si'/'dale'/'generar'/'confirmar', click #o-guardar to submit the order.

9. Implement new function parsearMaterialLocal(texto) that locally parses material dictation: (a) Use regex to extract quantity (numbers at start or embedded). (b) Detect unit from known UNIDADES list or common aliases (metros/metro/m, unidades/unidad/und). (c) Strip quantity+unit to get the material name search term. (d) Search estado.materiales using normTxt() includes matching. (e) If exact match found, return {materialId, nombre, cantidad, unidad}. (f) If fuzzy/partial match found, ask 'Te refieres a [nombre completo]?' and wait for yes/no in a sub-state. (g) If no match, speak 'No encontre ese material' and stay in paso='materiales'.

10. Modify the existing detectarIntencionLocal function's 'nueva salida' / 'generar salida' regex match to: open modal via modalOrden('salida', null), set asistente.flujo.paso = 'responsable', and speak 'Nueva salida. Para que responsable?' instead of calling the old abrirModalPorVoz.
11. Keep all other local detection patterns (navigation, other modals, confirmation when NOT in flujo). Keep enviarTextoAlAgente and despacharAccionIA as fallback for complex commands.
12. In src/renderer/index.html line 219, change renderer.js?v=47 to renderer.js?v=48.
